PELAGOS / GLASSWATER ISLAND
RECONNAISSANCE OVERVIEW
SITUATION

The island’s emergency network has gone dark. A breakaway security force is holding six grid engineers while its Cinder launcher prepares to destroy the evacuation route.

You fly Kestrel Seven: one gunship, four rescue seats. There is no backup aircraft.

  1. 01
    Blind their radar

    Destroy both relays. Missile crews lose coordination.

  2. 02
    Bring all six engineers home

    Clear three shelters. Hold E to winch. Deliver at HOME.

  3. 03
    Stop Cinder. Extract.

    After evacuation, intercept the moving launcher before launch. Return home.

FIELD ADVANTAGE Clear the central depot to unlock two forward service packs. Your home pad has unlimited supplies.

The field manual.

W A S D / ArrowsFly in screen directionsMouseAim independently of flightLeft mouse / SPACEFire selected weapon1 2 3 / QSelect / cycle weaponsSHIFTCruise · consumes more fuelHold EBrake, hover & winch / serviceFFlares · decoy incoming missilesTAB / MTactical map · click to markMouse wheelZoom cameraESCPause / resume

Fight with your route, not just your guns.

Circle while firing. Orange impact circles mark tank shells. Save seekers for armour: keep the reticle over a target until the lock completes. Release the chain gun to cool it.

Clear hostiles near a shelter before winching. Engineers only count as rescued after you deliver them at HOME. Your cabin holds four; service pads refill all weapons, fuel, hull and flares.

TOUCH: left stick to fly; right stick to aim and fire. Use WINCH, FLARE and weapon buttons. Landscape recommended.

STANDARD GAMEPAD: left/right sticks to fly/aim, right trigger to fire, A to winch, B for flares, shoulders to switch, Y for map, Start to pause / resume. Left-stick click to cruise. Use mouse or keyboard in the other menus.
